items.title: Judge denies motion to dismiss containerboard price-fixing lawsuit
items.summary: The federal judge cited significant consolidation within the containerboard market and “nearly lockstep price increases.” Many of the industry’s largest companies now move ahead to discovery.

items.title: PCA, Pactiv, Anchor made facility closure announcements in August
items.summary: Packaging Corporation of America is permanently closing its full-line plant in Gas City, Indiana, with dozens of layoffs expected in October.

items.title: What Are Wall Street Analysts' Target Price for Packaging Corporation of America Stock?
items.summary: Packaging Corporation of America has slightly underperformed the market, but strong shipments and a moderately bullish analyst outlook support a moderately optimistic outlook.

items.title: Used box businesses eye opportunity amid rising containerboard prices
items.summary: Growth has been a slow burn for two leading used box resellers, but rising corrugated prices could provide a push. Some corrugated experts still question whether this will move the needle.

items.title: Packaging Corp. (PKG) Up 6.7% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Continue?
items.summary: Packaging Corp. (PKG) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

items.title: 3 Mid-Cap Stocks We Approach with Caution
items.summary: Mid-cap stocks often strike the right balance between having proven business models and market opportunities that can support $100 billion corporations. However, they face intense competition from scaled industry giants and can be disrupted by new innovative players vying for a slice of the pie.

items.title: Amcor Q4 Earnings Beat Estimates on Berry Global Acquisition
items.summary: AMCR beats Q4 earnings estimates as the Berry Global acquisition, synergies, volume growth and productivity lift earnings and margins.

items.title: Pricing actions dominate quarterly fiber discussions
items.summary: Executives from Clearwater Paper, Huhtamaki, Mondi and Sylvamo described price increases and other actions to offset challenging market conditions, including a drag from the war with Iran.
